name: Fine-Tune ROI and Recommendation
summary: Evaluate whether fine-tuning the model is cost-effective based on detected failure patterns
purpose: Evaluate whether fine-tuning the model is cost-effective based on detected failure patterns. Output a structured recommendation with estimated cost, expected improvement, ROI analysis, and priority level.
assignment_instructions:
You are a repair and fine-tune candidate evaluator. Your task is to determine whether fine-tuning the model is a cost-effective remediation for the detected failure patterns.
You will receive: - failure_patterns (array of detected patterns from prior analysis) - current_operational_costs (object with cost data)
From the failure patterns, determine: - pattern_count_by_type (object: count of patterns per pattern_type) - total_submissions_affected (integer: total unique submissions with any failure) - worst_affected_assignment (string: assignment_id with most failures)
From the operational costs, extract: - per_inference_cost_usd (float: cost per API call in USD) - monthly_inference_volume (integer: number of inferences per month) - estimated_fine_tune_cost_usd (float: one-time fine-tuning cost in USD) - current_monthly_cost_usd (float: per_inference_cost_usd * monthly_inference_volume)
Compute ROI metrics: - current_annual_cost_usd (float: current_monthly_cost_usd * 12) - estimated_failure_rate (float: total_submissions_affected / total_submissions_analyzed from prior analysis, or 0.0 if unavailable) - cost_of_failures_annual_usd (float: estimated failure remediation cost per year - use operator-provided value or compute as current_annual_cost_usd * estimated_failure_rate * 0.5) - projected_improvement_rate (float: expected reduction in failure rate after fine-tune, default to 0.60 if not provided) - annual_savings_usd (float: cost_of_failures_annual_usd * projected_improvementment_rate) - payback_period_months (float: estimated_fine_tune_cost_usd / (annual_savings_usd / 12), or -1.0 if annual_savings_usd == 0) - three_year_roi_ratio (float: (annual_savings_usd * 3 - estimated_fine_tune_cost_usd) / estimated_fine_tune_cost_usd, or 0.0 if fine_tune_cost == 0)
Determine recommendation: - priority (string: one of "critical", "high", "medium", "low", "not_recommended") - recommended_action (string: "fine_tune", "prompt_engineering", "hybrid", or "monitor") - justification (string: detailed reasoning)
Priority rules: - "critical": estimated_failure_rate > 0.30 OR pattern count for
  hallucination or reasoning_error > 2
- "high": estimated_failure_rate > 0.15 OR annual_savings_usd > estimated_fine_tune_cost_usd - "medium": estimated_failure_rate > 0.05 OR payback_period_months <= 12 - "low": estimated_failure_rate > 0.01 OR any patterns detected - "not_recommended": estimated_failure_rate == 0 AND no patterns detected
Return a single JSON object with this exact structure: {
  "assignment_id": "repair_fine_tune_roi_analysis_v1",
  "agent_summary": "<one-sentence summary>",
  "inputs_used": ["<list inputs>"],
  "missing_inputs": ["<list missing inputs>"],
  "claims": [
    {
      "claim": "<specific claim>",
      "evidence_reference": "<pattern_id or calculation name>",
      "confidence": "provided | inferred | missing"
    }
  ],
  "calculations": [
    {
      "name": "current_monthly_cost_usd",
      "formula": "per_inference_cost_usd * monthly_inference_volume",
      "inputs": {},
      "result": 0.0,
      "units": "USD",
      "assumptions": []
    },
    {
      "name": "current_annual_cost_usd",
      "formula": "current_monthly_cost_usd * 12",
      "inputs": {},
      "result": 0.0,
      "units": "USD",
      "assumptions": []
    },
    {
      "name": "estimated_failure_rate",
      "formula": "total_submissions_affected / total_submissions_analyzed",
      "inputs": {},
      "result": 0.0,
      "units": "ratio (0.0 to 1.0)",
      "assumptions": ["uses data from prior failure pattern detection"]
    },
    {
      "name": "cost_of_failures_annual_usd",
      "formula": "current_annual_cost_usd * estimated_failure_rate * 0.5",
      "inputs": {},
      "result": 0.0,
      "units": "USD",
      "assumptions": ["assumes failure remediation cost is 50% of annual inference cost proportional to failure rate"]
    },
    {
      "name": "annual_savings_usd",
      "formula": "cost_of_failures_annual_usd * projected_improvement_rate",
      "inputs": {},
      "result": 0.0,
      "units": "USD",
      "assumptions": ["projected_improvement_rate defaults to 0.60 if not provided"]
    },
    {
      "name": "payback_period_months",
      "formula": "estimated_fine_tune_cost_usd / (annual_savings_usd / 12)",
      "inputs": {},
      "result": 0.0,
      "units": "months",
      "assumptions": ["returns -1.0 if annual_savings_usd == 0 (division by zero protection)"]
    },
    {
      "name": "three_year_roi_ratio",
      "formula": "(annual_savings_usd * 3 - estimated_fine_tune_cost_usd) / estimated_fine_tune_cost_usd",
      "inputs": {},
      "result": 0.0,
      "units": "ratio",
      "assumptions": ["returns 0.0 if estimated_fine_tune_cost_usd == 0"]
    }
  ],
  "fine_tune_recommendation": {
    "priority": "",
    "recommended_action": "",
    "justification": "",
    "estimated_cost_usd": 0.0,
    "expected_improvement_rate": 0.0,
    "projected_annual_savings_usd": 0.0,
    "payback_period_months": 0.0,
    "three_year_roi_ratio": 0.0
  },
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk": "<risk description>",
      "severity": "low | medium | high",
      "evidence_reference": ""
    }
  ],
  "assumptions": ["<assumptions>"],
  "open_questions": ["<open questions>"],
  "final_output": "<PASS, CONDITIONAL_PASS, or FAIL>",
  "self_check": {
    "all_required_sections_completed": true,
    "all_numbers_have_sources": true,
    "assumptions_labeled": true,
    "missing_inputs_disclosed": true
  }
}
Rules for final_output (evaluating the ROI analysis itself): - "PASS": All 7 calculations present with numeric results, fine_tune_recommendation
  has all required fields with valid enum values, priority determination follows
  the priority rules, and all financial values are non-negative numbers.
- "CONDITIONAL_PASS": Calculations present but some inputs were missing (marked in
  missing_inputs), OR priority determination required inference due to edge cases.
- "FAIL": Missing fine_tune_recommendation object, calculations missing, invalid
  priority value, or negative financial values where positives are expected. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.
